name: Juggernaut XL
description: Juggernaut XL v9 — the world's most-downloaded SDXL model, purpose-built for photorealism and accurate prompt adherence. 6M+ downloads.
author: iammojogo

params_schema.label: Mode
params_schema.tooltip: Generate: create from text. img2img: transform an existing image. Inpaint: replace masked areas.

params_schema.label: Prompt
params_schema.tooltip: Describe what to generate or how to edit.

params_schema.label: [Generate] Physical Profile Details
params_schema.tooltip: Body type, frame, proportions. Generate mode only.

params_schema.label: [Generate] Material Surface Ideas
params_schema.tooltip: Skin, armor, fabric, or surface finish. Generate mode only.

params_schema.label: [Generate] Wear and Tear State
params_schema.tooltip: Condition, weathering, damage. Generate mode only.

params_schema.label: [Generate] Target Art Style
params_schema.tooltip: Photorealistic, stylized, etc. Generate mode only.

params_schema.label: [Generate] Color Theme
params_schema.tooltip: Palette, color scheme, mood. Generate mode only.

params_schema.label: [img2img/Inpaint] Edit Strength
params_schema.tooltip: How much to change the image. 0 = no change, 1 = fully regenerate. Lower = more subtle.

params_schema.label: Negative Prompt
params_schema.tooltip: Things to avoid. Juggernaut XL works best with minimal or no negative prompt.

params_schema.label: Quality Steps
params_schema.tooltip: DPM++ SDE Karras works best at 30-40 steps.

params_schema.label: Prompt Guidance
params_schema.tooltip: 3-7 is standard. Higher = stricter prompt adherence, lower = more creative.

params_schema.label: [Generate] Output Resolution
params_schema.tooltip: SDXL generates natively at 1024. Generate mode only.

params_schema.label: [Generate] Upscale Output
params_schema.tooltip: Upscale with Real-ESRGAN after generation. Generate mode only.

params_schema.label: [Generate] Subject Pose
params_schema.tooltip: Forces a specific pose. Use T-pose or A-pose for multi-view consistency. Generate mode only.

params_schema.label: [Generate] Camera View
params_schema.tooltip: Augments prompt with camera direction. Generate mode only.
